description: MainActivity.kt defines the main activity for an Android app implementing a calculator with voice input. It manages UI components such as the voice search bar, result display, and calculator keypad, and wires user interactions to evaluate expressions.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity managing the calculator UI with voice input and keypad interaction.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, and wires calculator keypad.

methods.name: updateResultBox
methods.description: Updates the displayed expression in the result box.

methods.name: evaluateAndShowResult
methods.description: Evaluates the current expression and updates the result display.

methods.name: wireCalculatorKeypad
methods.description: Sets up button click listeners for calculator keypad buttons.
